situation: Writing the merge-gate mutation plan tests/fixtures/mutations/i<N>.json for a fix whose repairs are several separate edits in one source file, tested by parametrized cases with non-ASCII IDs.
right_direction: Declare one change per file whose repaired snippet spans all the edits contiguously; make removed the fixed region with each repair switched off, not main's code, so the tests fail with AssertionError only; run a draft plan with --report and copy the real failing node IDs and assertion messages into expected, then rerun until Mutation PASS.
anti_pattern: Listing several changes for the same path (rejected as duplicate target); reverting to main's code when it raises ValueError on an edge case (not a behavioral assertion); hand-typing parametrize node IDs that pytest escapes.
